title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-02-14
source: SBD -> (8 Track) Master Reel -> Dat -> CD -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording captures a historic February 14 1968 show with smoking Dark Star > China Cat > The Eleven and an all‑time great Anthem of the Sun second set.
ai_review.review: This Miller soundboard source is remarkably clear for its era, delivering a vivid picture of one of the Dead’s most celebrated Valentine’s Day concerts. The performance is high‑energy throughout – from a classic first set featuring Morning Dew and a tight Dark Star sequence to an almost flawless Anthem‑of‑the‑Sun second set with Cryptical > The Other One, New Potato and a soaring Spanish Jam. Minor issues such as Phil’s occasional flat tuning and a softer vocal on Alligator are noted, but they hardly detract from the overall brilliance.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive 5‑star reviews (≈80% of ratings) praise both the performance and the recording; only a few modest criticisms lower the average slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix that captures the band’s dynamics; reviewers note it as remarkable for 1968 and superior to many later releases, with only occasional minor tuning or vocal balance quirks.

standout_songs: Dark Star > China Cat > The Eleven
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set rolls through classic ’68 material with tight transitions; second set delivers the Anthem‑of‑the‑Sun suite and a powerful jam sequence, only tapering slightly toward the very end.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeated praise for Jerry’s guitar tone (‘perfect’, ‘blazing fret board’) with one outlier noting it didn’t sound like him at times.
band_member_comments.Phil: Generally praised for improvisational flights, but a reviewer calls out flat tuning on Phil during the show.
